title: PLVS Dark
summary: The built-in dark theme for PLVS, with neutral surfaces, balanced contrast, and the original orange-and-blue metering palette.
descriptionMarkdown: PLVS Dark is the built-in dark theme for everyday monitoring. Neutral charcoal surfaces keep the workspace quiet, while balanced contrast and the original orange-and-blue data palette preserve clear distinctions across every meter. Its restrained character makes it a dependable starting point and a visual reference for other PLVS themes.
